supporting_quotes.exact:
Pipelining doesn’t help latency of single instruction
it helps throughput of entire workload

observations.subject: pipelining
observations.object: throughput of the entire workload rather than latency of a single instruction

claims.rationale: 引文明确表示流水线不改善单条指令延迟，而改善整个工作负载的吞吐。target 原文区间为 [0,92)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。

supporting_quotes.exact:

being used by another instruction in the pipeline

supporting_quotes.exact:
RAW data hazards occur when one instruction depends on a data value
produced by a preceding instruction still in the pipeline.

claims.rationale: 引文直接说明 RAW 冒险涉及后续指令依赖前序指令产生、且前序指令仍在流水线中的数据值。target 原文区间为 [0,125)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Control Hazards: Whether or not an instruction should be executed
depends on a control decision made by an earlier instruction

observations.subject: control hazard
observations.object: whether an instruction executes depends on a control decision made by an earlier instruction

claims.rationale: 引文直接说明一条指令是否执行取决于更早指令作出的控制决策。target 原文区间为 [0,124)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。

supporting_quotes.exact:
WAW and WAR Name Hazards: An instruction in the pipeline is
writing a register that an earlier instruction in the pipeline is either
writing or reading

observations.subject: WAW and WAR
observations.object: name hazards involving a register written by an instruction and written or read by an earlier instruction

claims.rationale: 引文将 WAW 和 WAR 明确标为名称冒险，并描述同一寄存器的写写或写读关系。target 原文区间为 [0,159)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Superscalar processors enable CPI < 1 (i.e., IPC > 1) by
executing multiple instructions in parallel

Can have both in-order and out-of-order superscalar processors,
but we will start by exploring in-order

observations.subject: superscalar processors
observations.object: instruction throughput by executing multiple instructions in parallel

claims.rationale: 第一条引文支持并行执行多条指令以获得 IPC > 1，第二条明确区分超标量处理器的 in-order 与 out-of-order 类型，因此超标量不等同于乱序执行。两个 target 区间分别为 [0,99) 与 [0,102)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。

supporting_quotes.exact:

instructions to avoid RAW hazards, potentially allowing
instructions to execute out of order
commit stage waits for pending bit of head to be clear
new instructions allocated ROB entries at tail

Reorder buffer (ROB)
– allocated in-order in D stage
– updated out-of-order in W stage
– deallocated in-order in C stage

observations.object: instructions to execute out of order

observations.subject: commit stage
observations.object: the pending bit of the ROB head to clear

observations.subject: ROB
observations.object: in order in the C stage

claims.rationale: 引文支持指令可能乱序执行，并显示 ROB 在尾部按序分配、在执行阶段乱序更新、在提交阶段按序释放；commit 等待 ROB head，支持按程序顺序提交。target 区间分别为 [0,140)、[0,54)、[0,46)、[0,118)。来源未提供可证明独立性的 provenance 字段，因此 independence_unknown。
